message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I could hear my friend across the street already freaking out. I mean, who knew power could go out in the middle of a perfectly sunny day? I grabbed my trusty flashlight and power bank, and soon enough, we were all huddled together with snacks and a couple of lanterns, keeping spirits high. It made me realize that having a little backup for those unexpected moments can turn a panic into a cozy night in. And hey, maybe I should share my stash of flashlights with my friend next time!
